1.text: Nuko hasigaye iminsi itandatu Pasika ikaba Yesu ajya i Betaniya, aho Lazaro, uwo Yesu yazuye yabaga.

2.text: Bamutekerayo ibyokurya bya nijoro, Marita arahereza, kandi na Lazaro yari umwe mu bicaranye na Yesu basangira.

3.text: Mariya yenda igice cy'indatira y'amavuta meza nk'amadahano y'agati kitwa narada y'igiciro cyinshi cyane, ayasiga ku birenge bya Yesu abihanaguza umusatsi we, inzu yose itāmamo ayo mavuta.

4.text: Nuko Yuda Isikariyota, umwe mu bigishwa be wendaga kumugambanira aravuga ati

5.text: “Ni iki gitumye aya mavuta atagurwa idenariyo magana atatu ngo bazifashishe abakene?”

6.text: Icyatumye avuga atyo si ukubabarira abakene, ahubwo ni uko yari umujura kandi ari we wari ufite umufuka w'impiya, akība ibyo babikagamo.

7.text: Yesu aravuga ati “Nimumureke ayabikire umunsi nzahambwa,

8.text: kuko abakene muri kumwe na bo iteka, ariko jyeweho ntituri kumwe iteka.”

9.text: Abantu benshi b'Abayuda bamenye ko ahari baraza, icyakora si ku bwa Yesu gusa, ahubwo ni ukugira ngo barebe na Lazaro yazuye.

10.text: Nuko abatambyi bakuru bajya inama yo kwica Lazaro na we,

11.text: kuko Abayuda benshi babavagamo ku bwe bakizera Yesu.

12.text: Bukeye bwaho, abantu benshi bari baje i Yerusalemu gutegereza iminsi mikuru bumvise yuko Yesu azayo,

13.text: benda amashami y'imikindo bajya kumusanganira, batera hejuru bati “Hoziyana, hahirwa uje mu izina ry'Uwiteka, ni we Mwami w'Abisirayeli.”

14.text: Yesu abonye icyana cy'indogobe, acyicaraho nk'uko byanditswe ngo

15.text: “Witinya, mukobwa w'i Siyoni,Dore Umwami wawe araje,Ahetswe n'icyana cy'indogobe.”

16.text: Ibyo abigishwa be ntibabimenye bwa mbere, ariko rero Yesu amaze guhabwa ubwiza bwe ni bwo bibutse ibyo ko byanditswe kuri we, kandi ko ari ko bamugenjeje.

17.text: Nuko ba bantu bari kumwe na we, ubwo yahamagaraga Lazaro ngo ave mu gituro akamuzura, bamubera abahamya.

18.text: Kandi ni cyo cyatumye abantu benshi bajya kumusanganira, kuko bumvise ko yakoze icyo kimenyetso.

19.text: Nuko Abafarisayo baravugana bati “Murarora yuko murushywa n'ubusa, dore rubanda rwose ruramukurikiye.”

20.text: Hariho Abagiriki mu baje gusenga mu minsi mikuru,

21.text: basanga Filipo w'i Betsayida y'i Galilaya, baramwinginga bati “Mutware, turashaka kureba Yesu.”

22.text: Filipo araza abibwira Andereya, Andereya na Filipo na bo baraza babibwira Yesu.

23.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Igihe kirasohoye ngo Umwana w'umuntu ahabwe ubwiza bwe.

24.text: Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko iyo akabuto k'ishaka kataguye hasi ngo gapfe kagumaho konyine, ariko iyo gapfuye kera imbuto nyinshi.

25.text: Ukunda ubugingo bwe arabubura, ariko uwanga ubugingo bwe muri iyi si, azaburinda ageze ku bugingo buhoraho.

26.text: Umuntu nankorera ankurikire, kuko aho ndi n'umugaragu wanjye ari ho azaba. Umuntu nankorera Data azamuha icyubahiro.

27.text: “None umutima wanjye urahagaze, kandi navuga iki? Nti ‘Data, nkiza undokore iki gihe’, kandi ari byo byanzanye ngo nkigeremo?

28.text: Data, ubahiriza izina ryawe.”Nuko ijwi rivugira mu ijuru riti “Ndaryubahirije, kandi nzongera kuryubahiriza.”

29.text: Abantu bahagaze aho baryumvise baravuga bati “Ni inkuba.” Abandi bati “Ni marayika uvuganye na we.”

30.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Iryo jwi ntirije ku bwanjye, rije ku bwanyu.

31.text: Ubu urubanza rw'ab'isi rurasohoye, ubu umutware w'ab'iyi si abaye igicibwa.

32.text: Nanjye nimanikwa hejuru y'isi, nzireherezaho abantu bose.”

33.text: Ibyo yabivugiye kugaragaza urupfu yendaga gupfa urwo ari rwo.

34.text: Rubanda baramusubiza bati “Twumvise mu mategeko ko Kristo azagumaho iteka ryose; none ni iki gitumye uvuga ngo ‘Umwana w'umuntu akwiriye kumanikwa’? Ese uwo Mwana w'umuntu ni nde nyine?”

35.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Hasigaye umwanya muto, umucyo ukiri muri mwe. Nimugende mugifite umucyo butabiriraho mukiri mu nzira, kuko ugenda mu mwijima atamenya iyo ajya.

36.text: Mwizere umucyo mugifite umucyo, kugira ngo mube abana b'umucyo.”Yesu amaze kuvuga atyo aragenda, arabīhisha.

37.text: Nubwo yakoreye ibimenyetso byinshi bingana bityo imbere yabo ntibamwizeye,

38.text: kugira ngo ijambo ry'umuhanuzi Yesaya risohore, iryo yavuze ngo“Mwami, ni nde wizeye ibyo twumvise?Kandi ukuboko k'Uwiteka kwahishuriwe nde?”

39.text: Ni cyo cyatumye badashobora kwizera, kuko Yesaya yongeye kuvuga ati

40.text: “Yabahumye amaso, ibanangira imitima,Ngo be kurebesha amaso no kumenyesha imitima,Bagahindukira ngo mbakize.”

41.text: Ibyo byavuzwe na Yesaya, kuko yabonye ubwiza bwa Yesu akamuvuga.

42.text: Nyamara mu batware na bo benshi baramwizeye, ariko ku bw'Abafarisayo ntibabyerura ngo badacibwa mu isinagogi,

43.text: kuko bakundaga gushimwa n'abantu kuruta gushimwa n'Imana.

44.text: Yesu aravuga cyane ati “Unyizera si jye aba yizeye, ahubwo aba yizeye uwantumye,

46.text: Naje mu isi ndi umucyo, kugira ngo unyizera wese ataguma mu mwijima.

47.text: Ariko umuntu niyumva amagambo yanjye ntayitondere, si jye umuciriyeho iteka, kuko ntazanywe no gucira abari mu isi ho iteka, ahubwo naje kubakiza.

48.text: Unyanga ntiyemere amagambo yanjye afite umuciraho iteka. Ijambo navuze ni ryo rizamuciraho iteka ku munsi w'imperuka.

49.text: Sinabivuze ku bwanjye, ahubwo Data wantumye ni we wantegetse ibyo nkwiriye kuvuga, n'ibyo nkwiriye kwigisha.

50.text: Nanjye nzi yuko itegeko rye ari ryo bugingo buhoraho. Nuko rero ibyo mvuga, mbivuga uko Data yabimbwiye.”
